title: Applied AI Engineer Deep‑Dive Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to master LLM integration, retrieval‑augmented generation, and production‑grade web deployment. By the end you’ll have polished portfolio projects and the habits needed for professional AI engineering.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build a solid base in programming, web fundamentals, and AI concepts.

milestones.title: Python (or TypeScript) Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: You can write clean, modular code and debug scripts confidently.

tasks.title: Complete Python basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the introductory Python curriculum, focusing on data structures and functions.

tasks.title: Write a CLI calculator in Python
tasks.description: Implement addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division with argument parsing.

tasks.title: Refactor the calculator using type hints
tasks.description: Add type annotations and run mypy to ensure static checking.

tasks.title: Review Python style guide (PEP 8)
tasks.description: Read the relevant sections on naming and formatting, then lint your code with flake8.

milestones.title: Web Basics for AI Apps
milestones.outcome: You can create a simple front‑end and serve it with a back‑end API.

tasks.title: Follow MDN’s “Learn HTTP” tutorial
tasks.description: Understand request methods, status codes, and JSON payloads.

tasks.title: Build a static HTML page with a form
tasks.description: Collect user text input and display it on the same page using vanilla JavaScript.

tasks.title: Create an Express server that returns JSON
tasks.description: Set up a Node.js project, define a GET endpoint, and test with curl.

tasks.title: Connect the form to the Express API
tasks.description: Submit the form via fetch, handle the response, and show results in the UI.

tasks.title: Document the API with OpenAPI spec
tasks.description: Write a minimal OpenAPI YAML file and generate docs with Swagger UI.

milestones.title: Intro to Large Language Models
milestones.outcome: You understand how LLM APIs work and can send basic prompts.

tasks.title: Read OpenAI API quickstart guide
tasks.description: Focus on authentication, request format, and response handling.

tasks.title: Write a script that calls ChatCompletion
tasks.description: Send a simple prompt and print the model’s reply.

tasks.title: Handle rate‑limit errors gracefully
tasks.description: Add retry logic with exponential backoff to your script.

tasks.title: Compare responses from two models
tasks.description: Call both gpt‑3.5‑turbo and gpt‑4, log differences, and note cost implications.

tasks.title: Summarize key API parameters in a cheat sheet
tasks.description: Create a markdown file listing temperature, top_p, max_tokens, etc.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Deepen expertise in prompting, retrieval, and evaluation.

milestones.title: Advanced Prompt Design
milestones.outcome: You can craft reliable, reusable prompts for varied tasks.

tasks.title: Study the Prompt Engineering guide on OpenAI docs
tasks.description: Read sections on few‑shot prompting and system messages.

tasks.title: Create a prompt template library in JSON
tasks.description: Define placeholders for input, instructions, and examples.

tasks.title: Test each template with 5 sample inputs
tasks.description: Run the templates via the API and record success rates.

tasks.title: Iterate on a failing template using chain‑of‑thought
tasks.description: Add step‑by‑step reasoning prompts and measure improvement.

tasks.title: Write a short reflection on prompt failures
tasks.description: Identify common pitfalls and note mitigation strategies.

milestones.title: Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG)
milestones.outcome: You can integrate vector stores and retrieve relevant context for LLMs.

tasks.title: Watch the free LangChain tutorial on YouTube
tasks.description: Focus on document loaders, embeddings, and vector stores.

tasks.title: Set up a local ChromaDB instance
tasks.description: Install Chroma, load a small PDF collection, and verify indexing.

tasks.title: Write a query function that returns top‑k chunks
tasks.description: Embed a user query, search the vector store, and return results.

tasks.title: Combine retrieved chunks with a prompt template
tasks.description: Pass context to the LLM and generate an answer with citations.

tasks.title: Document the RAG pipeline in a diagram
tasks.description: Use draw.io to illustrate data flow from ingestion to response.

milestones.title: Systematic Evaluation
milestones.outcome: You can measure prompt quality and model performance with metrics.

tasks.title: Read the Evaluation section of the LLM Eval Guide on GitHub
tasks.description: Learn about accuracy, relevance, and hallucination metrics.

tasks.title: Implement a BLEU‑style scorer for generated answers
tasks.description: Compare model output against a reference set and compute scores.

tasks.title: Run the scorer on 20 sample prompts
tasks.description: Collect scores, calculate average, and note outliers.

tasks.title: Create a dashboard in Streamlit to visualize results
tasks.description: Plot score distributions and filter by prompt version.

tasks.title: Reflect on evaluation limitations in a journal entry
tasks.description: Write a brief note on what the metrics miss and next steps.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Apply the core skills to three portfolio‑grade projects.

milestones.title: Document Q&A App with Citations
milestones.outcome: You can deliver a web app that answers user questions using RAG and shows source references.

tasks.title: Define project scope and UI mockup
tasks.description: Sketch the main page, input box, and results area with citations.

tasks.title: Ingest a public PDF corpus into ChromaDB
tasks.description: Write a script that loads, splits, and indexes the documents.

tasks.title: Connect front‑end form to LLM via FastAPI
tasks.description: Create an endpoint that runs the RAG pipeline and returns JSON.

tasks.title: Add citation links that open source snippets
tasks.description: Render each answer with clickable footnotes pointing to original text.

tasks.title: Deploy the app on Render free tier
tasks.description: Configure Dockerfile, environment variables, and verify live URL.

milestones.title: Tool‑Using AI Agent
milestones.outcome: You can build an autonomous agent that calls external APIs or executes code.

tasks.title: Outline agent capabilities and required tools
tasks.description: Decide which APIs (e.g., weather, calculator) the agent will access.

tasks.title: Implement tool‑calling logic with LangChain’s StructuredOutputParser
tasks.description: Parse LLM responses to trigger function calls.

tasks.title: Create mock endpoints for each tool
tasks.description: Set up simple Flask routes that return deterministic data.

tasks.title: Run end‑to‑end scenarios and log success rate
tasks.description: Execute 10 diverse user requests and record how often the agent uses the correct tool.

tasks.title: Write a short case study for your portfolio
tasks.description: Explain the problem, architecture, and key challenges solved.

milestones.title: Prompt Evaluation Harness
milestones.outcome: You can systematically benchmark prompts across models and datasets.

tasks.title: Design a JSON schema for test cases
tasks.description: Include fields for prompt, expected answer, and metadata.

tasks.title: Code a runner that executes prompts on multiple models
tasks.description: Loop through test cases, call each model, and store raw outputs.

tasks.title: Integrate the BLEU scorer from Phase 2
tasks.description: Automatically compute scores for each model‑prompt pair.

tasks.title: Generate a comparative report in Markdown
tasks.description: Summarize findings, highlight best‑performing prompts, and note failures.

tasks.title: Publish the harness on GitHub with a README
tasks.description: Add installation steps, usage examples, and a license.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced practices, professional habits, and job‑search readiness.

milestones.title: Production‑Ready Shipping
milestones.outcome: You can ship, monitor, and maintain AI web services at scale.

tasks.title: Read the Twelve‑Factor App guide on Heroku blog
tasks.description: Focus on config, logs, and stateless processes.

tasks.title: Add structured logging with Python’s logging module
tasks.description: Emit JSON logs and test log rotation locally.

tasks.title: Set up health‑check endpoint in FastAPI
tasks.description: Return 200 OK when dependencies are reachable.

tasks.title: Configure CI/CD with GitHub Actions for tests and deployment
tasks.description: Write a workflow that lints, runs unit tests, and pushes to Render.

tasks.title: Write a post‑mortem for a simulated outage
tasks.description: Describe root cause, mitigation, and future safeguards.

milestones.title: Advanced Retrieval Techniques
milestones.outcome: You can apply hybrid search and fine‑tuned embeddings for better relevance.

tasks.title: Study hybrid search article on Pinecone blog (free)
tasks.description: Learn how to combine keyword and vector similarity.

tasks.title: Fine‑tune a small sentence‑transformer on domain data
tasks.description: Use Hugging Face’s Trainer API on a labeled dataset.

tasks.title: Replace base embeddings in your RAG app with the fine‑tuned model
tasks.description: Re‑index documents and compare relevance scores.

tasks.title: Benchmark latency and cost before/after change
tasks.description: Record average query time and token usage for 100 queries.

tasks.title: Document lessons learned in a technical blog post
tasks.description: Explain why fine‑tuning helped and trade‑offs involved.

milestones.title: Career Launch
milestones.outcome: You are prepared to interview and present your AI engineering portfolio.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn with project screenshots and descriptions
tasks.description: Write concise bullet points highlighting impact and tech stack.

tasks.title: Create a 5‑minute demo video for each portfolio project
tasks.description: Record screen, narrate architecture, and upload to YouTube (unlisted).

tasks.title: Practice system‑design interview questions on Pramp (free)
tasks.description: Focus on scaling LLM services and data pipelines.

tasks.title: Write STAR stories for three key achievements
tasks.description: Structure each story with Situation, Task, Action, Result.

tasks.title: Send personalized outreach emails to 5 target companies
tasks.description: Reference a relevant project and ask for a brief chat.
